text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — post-launch microcycle proposal: 3 high-priority bugs + 2 scoped UX/enhancements over next 2 weeks. want alignment and any must-take customer asks.
Aaron (Eng): +1 to narrow scope. can we get rough dev estimates before locking?
Priya (QA): pls share repros for the 3 bugs. i have a regression suite ready but need test data.
Maya (PM): summary of candidates: 1) search scoring regression (sev-2, customer impact) 2) streaming dropouts at >1024 tokens (intermittent p99) 3) rerank latency spike for batch sizes >8. enhancements: A) compact results UI tweak (low effort) B) token-cost telemetry in console (medium).
Luis (CS): search scoring is from ACME customer — they've escalated. they see wrong ordering for 10% of queries.
Chen (Design): compact results UI tweak: I can scope as a 3-screen flow and provide assets by end of day tomorrow. low dev surface.
Aaron (Eng): initial rough estimates: search fix 2w (investigate + deploy), streaming dropout 3-5d (root cause likely kv-cache), rerank latency 4d (profiling + fix), UI tweak 2d, telemetry 6d + small infra work.
Priya (QA): i can smoke the UI tweak and rerank in parallel. search fix needs integration tests with customer dataset; will need access.
Maya (PM): thanks — based on estimates that's >2w if we take everything. proposal: prioritize search fix (customer SLA) + UI tweak this cycle. leave streaming / rerank for next microcycle unless dev capacity opens.
Aaron (Eng): that sounds reasonable. if we cut telemetry now we can free 2 dev-days.
Sam (SRE): FYI the infra quota for dedicated region is tight this week — any heavy retraining or canarying that needs extra GPU should be scheduled next week.
Maya (PM): noted. Luis, can you ask ACME for priority window to give us timebox?
Luis (CS): pinged them — they can accept a 2-week window but want a patch earlier if possible. they asked for an interim fallback.
Aaron (Eng): interim fallback could be an A/B routing to previous model variant for affected customers. low-risk toggle.
Chen (Design): for the UI tweak: small A/B; i'll provide copy options. prefer to ship as feature flag.
Priya (QA): testing plan: add regression cases for ACME queries, run staging canary for 48h, sanity checks on embed similarity.
Maya (PM): acceptance criteria for search fix: top-1 order matches baseline on 95% of sample queries, no degradation in latency >5%.
Aaron (Eng): noted. i'll pair with Priya on test harness and mock ACME dataset.
deploy-bot: deploy queued — staging build 2026-03-18_14:22 (candidate for quick validation). :rocket:
Maya (PM): next: define rollback and rollout plan. 1) canary to 5% 2) monitor p99 lat, ordering metric, errors 3) expand if green.
Sam (SRE): add alert for ordering metric drop >3% and p99 >200ms. I'll add the dashboards.
Luis (CS): once we have a canary, i'll share with ACME and offer a quick validation session.
Maya (PM): final ask: everyone ping if capacity changes. I'll update the roadmap board and move streaming/rerank to next microcycle. thanks all. :thumbsup:
